author: manekruspopo
quote: With this turd, the spirit of GTA have been lost. The game will be forever remembered as the last straw sealing the fate of the franchise and it's slipover from having the legendary status GTA always had. Sings were in the air yet everyone's suprised but at the very least the general public will already know what to expect from Rockstar and every other triple A studio coming forward.
